video.decoding_capability: Live view: 1 stream x 1080p at 30 fps; 4 split x 1080p at 30 fps; 9 split x 720p at 15 fps

power.supply: Max 180 W, 105 W PoE; 100–240 V AC, 2.3 A, 50/60 Hz; 54 V DC, 3.3 A; external power adapter

features: 8 AXIS Camera Station Pro Core Device NVR licenses and 10 AXIS Audio Manager Pro licenses included
Integrated PoE switch: 8x PoE ports 10/100 Mbps, 1x RJ45 10/100/1000 Mbps (switch), 1x RJ45 10/100/1000 Mbps (server)
PoE total power budget class allocation 125 W, power consumption limit 105 W
Validated for basic surveillance up to 1080p
Qualified for 16 doors and 8 video channels

FIPS 140-2 level 2 certified Trusted Platform Module (TPM 2.0)
notes: Datasheet gives power consumption of 24 W recording only, 27 W typical use case and 30 W worst use case.
